We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. We understand that you are disputing the accuracy of the account information. We take all disputes seriously and will investigate the matter.

We are required by law to provide you with a validation notice within 30 days of receiving your dispute. However, we have determined that your dispute is not a request for validation, but rather a dispute of the account information. We will investigate this matter further and respond accordingly.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to provide you with a written acknowledgment of your dispute. We are doing so in this letter. You have the right to dispute the debt and request validation of the debt. If you wish to continue to dispute the debt, please provide us with additional information or documentation to support your claim.

We will conduct a thorough investigation of this matter and respond to you in writing once we have completed our review.
